name: Bufo's GPU Heist
tagline: Sneak past the sysadmin cats and steal every GPU in the datacenter.
description: Bufo is on a heist in a Mistral datacenter. Bump blinking racks to grab GPUs (two at a time) and carry them back to the burrow. Sysadmin cats patrol the taped routes, and security cats chase you with A* once they spot you. Hide in cable bundles until they give up.
win_text: Every GPU is in the burrow. Bufo's cluster is now the biggest in the swamp.
lose_text: Caught by a sysadmin cat! Bufo is escorted out of the datacenter.
